description.short_caption: Fingernail with subungual discoloration and nail plate irregularity.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a fingernail with a white discoloration beneath the nail plate, consistent with subungual involvement. The nail plate appears thickened and irregular, with evidence of onycholysis (separation of the nail from the nail bed). The surrounding skin is intact, with no overt signs of inflammation or erythema.
